text: If your weekend plans need dry skies, today's not cooperating: a frontal system is crossing right on top of us, with showers likely from morning on and thunderstorms mixing in through the afternoon and evening. High near 79, but the models are split hard on just how wet it gets, the American model wants a drier day while the European model is soaked, so I'd trust the higher end and keep the rain jacket handy rather than packed away. Some of those evening storms could turn heavy, and an isolated strong one can't be ruled out, though the risk stays low. The lake's churned up too, southeast wind building to 10 to 15 knots with numerous showers and storms expected by afternoon, so plan to be off the water well before evening. Monday doesn't clear things out either, lingering cyclonic flow keeps showers and thunderstorms likely through midday with a high near 76. Best bet today: get outdoor errands done early, treat any afternoon plans as rain-or-shine with a backup indoors, and skip the boat until this system fully clears late tonight.
